name: gtm-coach-pro
description: Conversational-intelligence sales coach. Discovers any connected meeting-recording tool, builds a long-horizon local memory bank from call summaries and transcripts, and coaches GTM strategy and execution using the SPICED framework. Pro adds a winning-call playbook builder, objection & competitor battlecards, and two-way voice-of-customer (call language + HubSpot AEO), plus CRM- and enrichment-grounded pre-call briefs.

author.name: Australia Go To Market / Dr. Robert Li
